lines.t: [Lyrics for Suno]
I stretched the heavens like a canvas over you.
I laid the streets where you bleed the truth.
I hear the cries that never make the news.
I am the First, the Last… and I’m coming through.(Soft R&B ad‑libs behind)
No contradiction in My love and My hatred,
I burn against the evil that rapes what I created.
Jealous over everything that’s Mine, I state it,
The fear of YAHUWAH is to hate what He hated.I’m fightin’ for My children with a fire unshaken,
River of mercy but the ground is quakin’.
Run to My arms while the gates still open,
Before the sky splits wide and the trumpets are spoken.
Yeah…
I see the block where the shots don’t sleep,
Chalk on the pavement, mothers that weep.
You pour out liquor, forget My Name,
Let the devil set prices on a human frame.You flip that work, think you own that turf,
But the dirt you stand on? I formed that earth.
You post your sins like it’s nothin’ at all,
But every DM’s read in My holy court hall.You call it hustle when you traffic My seed,
Turn My daughters to products, dress it up as “need.”
You tattoo crosses while you mock My grace,
Wear My Name on your neck but you hide your face.Still My heart bleeds heavy when you lose your way,
Jealous like a Husband when His bride won’t stay.
Like a Father in the hood when his sons get jumped,
I’m ready to ride, but you won’t get in the truck.
My jealousy burns, but it’s fueled by love,
I’m a roaring fire, but My heart’s undone.
I hate the evil that’s been eating you alive,
I’m ready to break chains, bring you back inside.(Soft falsetto)
I’m still here… I’m still here for you…
No contradiction in My love and My hatred,
I burn against the evil that rapes what I created.
Jealous over everything that’s Mine, I state it,
The fear of YAHUWAH is to hate what He hated.I’m fightin’ for My children with a fire unshaken,
River of mercy but the ground is quakin’.
Run to My arms while the gates still open,
When the bassline fades and the lights go black,
Bass hit, lights out, idols fall flat.
Every fake god, I’ma peel ‘em right back.
Storm in the speakers, heaven in the track,
King on the throne and I’m takin’ Mine back.(Ethereal vocal stabs)
I seen the leaders in the towers of glass,
Sellin’ souls on a screen for a lil’ more cash.
They sign them papers, blood in the pen,
Then tell the youth “it’s love” when it’s death in the end.You pass laws that legitimize sin,
Smile in your suits while you lock ‘em all in.
You play God in a room with a vote and a lens,
But the real God sees when your session begins.You laugh at My warnings, say I ain’t real,
But you pray real fast when the plane start to tilt.
You scream My Name when the bullets rain,
But you curse Me out when I call you to change.Listen—
I’m not distant, I’m in that cell,
I’m in that alley where your best friend fell.
I’m in that moment when your last nerve snaps,
I laid the streets where you bleed the truth.
I’m the line between your darkness and light,
The cord that holds you when you’re losin’ the fight.
Love like thunder, fire that refines,
Wrath that rises for the ones that are Mine.(Answer line, softer)
Wrath from sorrow, anger from love,
A Father protectin’ what He’s jealous of.(Soaring)
You call it hate when I expose your night,
No contradiction in My love and My hatred,
I burn against the evil that rapes what I created.
Jealous over everything that’s Mine, I state it,
The fear of YAHUWAH is to hate what He hated.I poured out My life so My sons ain’t wasted,
Blood on the cross, every debt I paid it.
If you still refuse what My hands have given,
Then the wrath you feel is the wrath you chosen.
Sky crack open, Son of Man descend.
Mountains kneel down, empires bend,
Every proud crown fly off in the wind.(Sung tags)
Ooooh… can you feel it in your chest now?
(Sung, tender but powerful)
No contradiction in My love and My hatred,
I’m jealous for the ones I created.
If you hear My voice in the beat tonight,
Turn around, step out of the night. (Spoken, low, close)
When the bassline fades and the lights go black,
You and Me gonna face these facts.
My love is a river, My hatred a flame,
For the evil that murders the ones in My name.
